name: ProjectMind for GitHub Copilot (VS Code & CLI/Harness)
description: Persistent project intelligence, VS Code .vscode/mcp.json, portable .mcp.json, and custom instructions for Copilot.

capabilities.restartInstructions: In VS Code Command Palette, run `MCP: List Servers` to confirm projectmind is running.
documentedLimitations: Standard VS Code Copilot Chat relies on .github/copilot-instructions.md and MCP tool discovery rather than shell lifecycle hooks.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install github-copilot` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update github-copilot` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall github-copilot` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
